subject: Insurance
title: Body Odor Insurance in Japan
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Body Odor Insurance in Japan.

hook.text: A Japanese insurer offers 'smell harassment' insurance.

buildup.text: Japan takes workplace scent sensitivity seriously.

discovery.text: The policy covers legal defense and settlements if a coworker sues over your scent. Premiums are about $10 per month.

twist.text: It's not a joke product—it reflects Japanese workplace culture where social harmony is legally enforceable.

climax.text: Cultural norms create insurance markets. What's a lawsuit in Tokyo is a punchline in New York.

punchline.text: $10/month against scent lawsuits. Culture defines insurable risk.

quiz.question: What is 'sumehara' in Japanese workplace culture?
options: Smell harassment—offensive body odor as a workplace complaint
